rules.statement: The de facto trustee of a Hindu temple is not entitled as such to obtain possession of its temporalities, and disputes between persons vested with legal title to endowments should be settled through a vesting order under section 112 of the Trusts Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: The de facto trustee of a Hindu temple is not entitled as such to obtain possession, of its temporalities. Our law does not recognize the personality of religious foundations.
